morphology_diagnostics.sampling: deterministic evenly-spaced stems, no random seed
morphology_diagnostics.interpretation: Binary masks are present and stem-matched, but a single centred coarse blob dominating each mask is consistent with an algorithmic proxy segmentation, NOT with documented expert lesion-boundary annotation. No provenance record for their creation exists in the repository.

id_overlap.note: all_paired.csv carries split assignment metadata for all 8,441 rows including TEST; only its ID column was read. test.csv was never opened. No TEST pixel was opened at any point.

image_hash_overlap.note: Only TRAIN+VAL ISIC image bytes were opened. TEST1683 image bytes were never opened. Size equality is a screening heuristic, not evidence of a match.

prediction_evidence.note: Filename-level metadata scan only; no pixel or mask opened. Hits are manifests, inventories, or audit prose, never saved ReMedFiLM FULL predictions. The single historical F5 HAM10000 ISIC_0024306 metric is GlobalMedFiLM-only, single-case, from checkpoint 286689fd...5ba1b7 (3,523,001 params) per c1_claim_provenance.json.

evaluation_status.reason: Official HAM10000 / ISIC-2018 Task 3 is a classification release with no expert segmentation masks. The 10,015 local binary masks have no provenance. No dataset-level ReMedFiLM FULL evaluation and no saved eligible FULL predictions exist. Producing Dice/IoU/HD95 against these masks would be scientifically unsupported.
